title: DDGS 2.0.0
release_notes:
**Search everything. Download anything.**

**Assistant**
- A reply, a search, or a page fetch now costs **1 credit**
- The current date and time go into every prompt, so "this week" means this week
- A live spinner around Stop, and a plain line under each step saying what ran and where it was saved
- Images are shown in the reply, not just described
- Chat history opens as a modal, backed by one transcript instead of two
- Save a page, download a video or image, crawl a whole site, or schedule a recurring crawl — all from the chat

**Premium**
- Pay by card, bank transfer or USDC through our payment partner on direct and desktop builds
- $3.99 / month, $24.99 / year, or $49.99 once
- A recovery ID restores your purchase on any device

**Fixes**
- Deleted chats stay deleted
- A conversation survives the app being closed mid-reply, and minimizing the Assistant no longer destroys it
